figurative_meaning_en: The beginning era of British rule
example_sentences_in_bangla: কোম্পানীর আমলে বাংলার অর্থনীতি ব্যাপকভাবে পরিবর্তিত হয়।
আমাদের ইতিহাসে কোম্পানীর আমল একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অধ্যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The economy of Bengal changed drastically during the Company era.
The Company era forms a significant chapter in our history.
history: Refers to the period starting from 1757 after the Battle of Plassey, when the East India Company gained control over Bengal, marking the onset of British colonial rule in India.
note: This idiom specifically alludes to the East India Company's dominance in the Indian subcontinent.
